title: Strict Tower Realization
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be the adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $P_n=A/I^n$, completed coefficient sheaves $A_T$, and strict quotient towers. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, $g:Y'\to Y$ any scheme map, and $X'=X\times_YY'$ with projections $f',g'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Supply a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with ambient map $\bar g$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ be derived $I$-complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with compatible witnesses $\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K_n$, $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Assume $j_!K$ is complete and identify its quotient tower with $j_!K_\bullet$ using the canonical tensor comparisons. Here $j_!$ is the exact ringed-site functor of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact].
Put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Tow}(\underline A_T)$ and let $\operatorname{Res}_T$ restrict along $\underline A_T\to A_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Use constant-coefficient strict-tower operations $G_u,R_u^{\mathcal T}$ and $J_j$ [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Restriction of scalars canonically commutes with $j_!$ on sheaves, complexes, and strict towers. For $M_\bullet=\operatorname{Res}_X K_\bullet$ define the actual strict-tower morphism
$$e^c_M=(R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}\beta_{j,\bar g})\circ E_p^{\mathcal T}:G_gR_p^{\mathcal T}J_jM_\bullet\longrightarrow R_{p'}^{\mathcal T}J_{j'}G_{g'}M_\bullet,$$
where $E_p^{\mathcal T}$ is the normalized proper mate [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] and $\beta$ the open unit-mate [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The ordered completed exchange $\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp},c}_!(K)$ of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], with its open factor specified by the ordered $R\lim(\beta)$ formula, is exactly the image of $R\lim(e^c_M)$ under the canonical constant/completed, finite-reduction, direct-image/limit, and extension/limit identifications [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits, lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit]. This identification is natural in $K$ and identifies evaluation of $e^c_M$ at each $n$ with the specified finite proper/open exchange; it does not characterize a tower map only by evaluations.

proof.text: Retain the already proved scalar/open, quotient/open, normalized limit-mate invertibility, product-preservation, evaluation, and endpoint-naturality arguments in StrictTowerRealizationComparisons. Their construction data and signatures are unchanged; the private tower-square normalization proof uses the existing towerSquare_localization equation before applying its generic localization lemma. The construction and open-factor definition nodes are reattached to that foundation. This extraction breaks the former dependency cycle, so the parent can now apply the declared strict-open mate identification.

For the open factor, completedOpenExchangeComparison supplies completeness of the extended input. Apply completedOpenStrictMateIdentification and postcompose with the inverse of its completed target comparison. Expand that inverse: it is inverse extension/limit, then inverse pullback presentation, then inverse scalar/open transport. This proves the published open-factor formula without changing its hypotheses.

The existing completedExchange_mate and restrictedExchange_mate helpers in strict normalization identify the actual strict proper factor before evaluation, for every input tower. Postcompose their equality with direct image of the pullback of the quotient/open comparison. Naturality of the constant strict proper mate moves that comparison to its source, giving exactly the two endpoint corners used by the parent. Thus no new transport of finite etale origins or Koszul completeness argument is needed in this assembly.
Use the scalar/direct-image/limit square of lem-cbc-strict-tower-scalar-push-limit-coherence at the pullback of the full quotient tower of j!K. Its maps are precisely the specified endpoint maps.

Apply cbcRealizationCombine, a fully proved abstract categorical cancellation lemma: naturality of scalar/direct-image moves the open factor through that comparison; the scalar/limit square cancels its inverse; naturality of the scalar/limit and direct-image/limit comparisons moves the remaining tower arrows. Substitute the proper normalization and open-factor formula, and combine the resulting tower maps by functoriality of Rlim. Expanding the endpoint definitions is exactly the stated main identity. All original theorem signatures, including the completeness and origin assumptions, are preserved.

tool_uses.why: Generic exact ringed-site open adjunction supplies the very j_! stipulated in the item, including non-finite coefficients.
Generic descent of an exact functor justifies degreewise open comparisons on unbounded derived categories.
Generic coefficient and finite-reduction comparison keeps constant and completed coefficients distinct and identifies the specified tower units.
Exact etale extension preserves each witness lower bound; the unit requires these witnesses and does not replace this general sheaf theorem.
Generic functorial derived inverse limit permits composition of actual tower maps for constant coefficient sheaves.
Proper base-change strict mate normalization is the proper factor explicitly required by the unit route.
Generic pro-etale module countable-product exactness verifies the hypotheses of the normalized strict-limit comparison.
Generic natural direct-image/limit comparison is needed to compose the proper and open factors on strict towers.
Unit-compatible reconstruction converts the assumed intrinsic completeness of j_!K to the quotient-unit hypothesis of proper normalization.
Exactness of finite-coefficient etale/pro-etale comparison pullback justifies the degreewise witness comparison on derived categories.
